/* LeaveDashboardMapper.selectDashboardMetrics */ SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.WITHDRAWAL_DATE IS NULL AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' ) AS totalEmployees , IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = G.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = G.USER_CD AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.WITHDRAWAL_DATE IS NULL AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ), 0) AS totalGranted , IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(G.USED_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = G.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = G.USER_CD AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.WITHDRAWAL_DATE IS NULL AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ), 0) AS totalUsed , ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT G.USER_CD) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = G.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = G.USER_CD AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.WITHDRAWAL_DATE IS NULL AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.GRANT_DAYS > G.USED_DAYS AND G.AVAIL_TO_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY), '%Y%m%d') ) AS expiringSoon30 , (
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT G.USER_CD) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = G.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = G.USER_CD AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.WITHDRAWAL_DATE IS NULL AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.GRANT_DATE LIKE CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m'), '%') ) AS newGrantThisMonth FROM DUAL

/* LeaveDashboardMapper.selectDetailUser */ SELECT U.USER_CD AS userCd , U.USER_NM AS userNm , N.NODE_NM AS deptNm , U.EMPLOYMENT_TYPE AS employmentType , U.HIRE_DATE AS hireDate , IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(C.CREDIT_MONTHS) FROM TB_USER_SERVICE_CREDIT C WHERE C.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND C.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ), 0) AS creditMonths , IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.GRANT_TYPE LIKE 'STATUTORY\_%' ), 0) AS legalGranted , IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(G.USED_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.GRANT_TYPE LIKE 'STATUTORY\_%' ), 0) AS legalUsed , IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.GRANT_TYPE LIKE 'MANUAL\_%' ), 0) AS nonLegalGranted , IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(G.USED_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.GRANT_TYPE LIKE 'MANUAL\_%' ), 0) AS nonLegalUsed , ( SELECT MIN(G.AVAIL_TO_DATE) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.GRANT_TYPE LIKE 'STATUTORY\_%' AND G.GRANT_DAYS > G.USED_DAYS ) AS legalNearestExpire FROM TB_USER U LEFT JOIN TB_SITE_NODE N ON N.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND N.SITE_CD = U.SITE_CD AND N.NODE_CD = U.NODE_CD WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd}

/* LeaveDashboardMapper.selectGrantHistory */ SELECT G.GRANT_ID AS grantId , G.GRANT_DATE AS grantDate , CASE WHEN G.GRANT_TYPE LIKE 'STATUTORY\_%' THEN 'LEGAL' ELSE 'NON_LEGAL' END AS natureBadge , G.GRANT_REASON AS reason , G.GRANT_DAYS AS granted , G.USED_DAYS AS used , (G.GRANT_DAYS - G.USED_DAYS) AS remaining , G.AVAIL_TO_DATE AS expiresAt , G.STATUS AS status , G.USED_DAYS AS usedDays , G.GRANT_BY_TYPE AS grantByType
, CASE WHEN G.GRANT_TYPE LIKE 'MANUAL\_%' AND G.GRANT_BY_TYPE = '02' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.USED_DAYS = 0 AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS canRecall FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND G.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY G.GRANT_DATE DESC, G.GRANT_ID DESC

/* LeaveDashboardMapper.selectManualGrantTypes */ SELECT T.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , T.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm FROM TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND T.LEAVE_TYPE = '02' AND T.GRANT_TYPE = '02' AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY T.LEAVE_NO ASC

/* LeaveDashboardMapper.selectRecallTarget */ SELECT G.GRANT_ID AS grantId , G.USER_CD AS userCd , G.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , G.GRANT_TYPE AS grantType , G.GRANT_BY_TYPE AS grantByType , G.GRANT_DAYS AS grantDays , G.USED_DAYS AS usedDays , G.STATUS AS status , G.DEL_YN AS delYn FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND G.GRANT_ID = #{grantId}

/* LeaveDashboardMapper.countActiveBySuffixVariant */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY LIKE CONCAT(REPLACE(#{baseKey}, '_', '\_'), '\_%')
